verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at maritime.sh, and there is a CLI-specific llms.txt with agent instructions. A dedicated AI-agents docs page explains how to hand an assistant one prompt so it can install the CLI, authenticate and deploy. missing for 10: markdown renditions of docs pages (docs.md returned 404) and independent corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://maritime.sh/llms.txt # Maritime
Pass --json on EVERY command. Success: one JSON value on stdout, stderr empty.
The Maritime CLI is built to be operated by other AI agents, not just humans: machine-readable output on every command, stable exit codes, and a live self-describing contract.
Paste one prompt into Claude, Cursor, or any assistant and it can install the CLI, authenticate, and deploy agents for you.
